message:
Chess vs AI: standalone copy of the game without the two-player mode

Branched from the pre-multiplayer build of fidgetrope/chess so there is a
separate link for playing the computer without any Firebase/online code.
Own base path (/chess-ai/), own page title (so home-screen shortcuts are
distinguishable) and own save slot (chess-ai.save.v1), since both sites
share the fidgetrope.github.io origin and would otherwise overwrite each
other's saved game.
